entities.summary: Julia Lemigova, born Yulia Andreevna Lemigova is a Russian former model and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Miss USSR 1990 and is married to Martina Navratilova. She was a cast member of the Bravo reality television series The Real Housewives of Miami.
